links.outcome: Readability of LLM gout responses (FKGL, ARI) for patient education
links.effect: GPT-5 produced the most complex responses (FKGL: 12.89 ± 2.22, ARI: 14.87 ± 2.40), with the lowest readability; DeepSeek-R1 generated the longest outputs.
links.quote: In terms of readability, GPT-5 produced the most complex responses (FKGL: 12.89 ± 2.22, ARI: 14.87 ± 2.40), while DeepSeek-R1 generated the longest outputs.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM gout patient-education responses
links.effect: GPT-5 responses averaged FKGL 12.89 and ARI 14.87, well above typical patient reading levels; GPT-5 had the lowest readability.
links.quote: In terms of readability, GPT-5 produced the most complex responses (FKGL: 12.89 ± 2.22, ARI: 14.87 ± 2.40), while DeepSeek-R1 generated the longest outputs.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (accuracy and readability) on questions derived from ACR gout guidelines without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
